title: Final block velocity
description: Essential: Correctly applies momentum conservation to obtain v = v₀/4.

title: Momentum conservation setup
description: Important: Sets up the correct momentum equation: m*v₀ = m*(v₀/2) + 2m*v.

title: Fall time calculation
description: Important: Correctly solves h = (1/2)gt² for the fall time t = √(2h/g).

title: Horizontal landing distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the range x = v*t = (v₀/4)*√(2h/g).

title: Energy loss calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes ΔE = initial KE - final KE = 5mv₀²/16.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Sets up the correct energy difference: ΔE = (1/2)mv₀² - [(1/2)m(v₀/2)² + (1/2)(2m)v²].

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for bullet's exit velocity (e.g., treating it as additive).

title: Incorrect mass in momentum
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong mass for the block (e.g., m instead of 2m) in the momentum equation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout or explicitly states them in final answers.
